# `mise bootstrap remote`

- **Usage:** `mise bootstrap remote [FLAGS] [TARGET]…`
- **Effect:** destructive — may delete or irreversibly overwrite
- **Source code:** [`src/cli/bootstrap.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/bootstrap.rs)

Bootstrap one or more machines over SSH

Packs a local project directory, copies it to each target, stages mise
there, and runs `mise bootstrap`. The directory is `--source`. Without it,
an inventory host uses its own `source`, then the one in
`[bootstrap.remote]`, then the current directory; a `--host` target uses
the current directory. Pick targets by name, `--tag`, or `--all` from
`[bootstrap.remote.hosts]`, or give any SSH destination with `--host`.

Targets need a POSIX shell plus `tar`, `mktemp`, `cksum`, and `uname`;
Windows targets are not supported. `--dry-run` still connects, uploads, and
inspects each target, but changes nothing there. With `--adopt`, each target
adopts the repository as `mise bootstrap --adopt` does, instead of receiving
a project directory.

The `--github-relay-*` flags let targets read private GitHub repositories
through this machine's credentials for the length of the run, without
copying a token to them. See <https://mise.jdx.dev/bootstrap/github-relay.html>.

## Arguments
- **`[TARGET]…`** — Inventory host names from `[bootstrap.remote.hosts]`

## Flags
- **`--adopt <GIT_URL|OWNER/REPO>`** — Adopt global configuration or shared dotfile history on each target
- **`--all`** — Select every inventory host
- **`--bootstrap-command <COMMAND>`** — Shell command, run on each target, that installs mise and puts it on PATH
- **`--connect-timeout <SECONDS>`** — SSH connection timeout in seconds

  **Default:** `10`
- **`--copy-link <PATH>`** — Copy the target of this source-relative symbolic link instead of the link; repeat for more
- **`--copy-links`** — Copy the targets of every symbolic link in the source instead of the links
- **`--exclude <PATTERN>`** — Another pattern to leave out of the archive; repeat for more
- **`--fail-fast`** — Stop after the first failed target
- **`--force-dotfiles`** — Overwrite files on each target that conflict with whole-file dotfile entries
- **`--host <[USER@]HOST>`** — SSH destination that is not in the inventory (`[user@]host`); repeat for more
- **`-i --identity-file <PATH>`** — SSH identity file, overriding the inventory and SSH config
- **`-n --dry-run`** — Show what would change on each target without changing it

  It still connects to each target, uploads the project, stages mise, and inspects the target.
- **`--install-mise[=PATH]`** — Install the provisioned mise on each host instead of only staging it

  Defaults to `~/.local/bin/mise`; pass `--install-mise=<PATH>` for another path.
- **`--keep-staging`** — Keep the remote staging directory for debugging
- **`--mise-bin <PATH>`** — Upload this local mise executable, for platforms without an official release binary
- **`--no-install-mise`** — Do not install mise on the host, even when the selected hosts configure it
- **`--only <PART>`** — Run only these parts on each target

  Repeat the flag or separate parts with commas. Cannot be combined with `--skip`.

  **Choices:** `plugins`, `packages`, `accounts`, `files`, `services`, `firewall`, `compose`, `repos`, `dotfiles`, `mise-shell-activate`, `macos-defaults`, `macos-launchd-agents`, `linux-systemd-units`, `user`, `tools`, `task`, `final-hook`
- **`--port <PORT>`** — SSH port, overriding the inventory and SSH config
- **`--prompt-secrets`** — Prompt securely for missing secret inputs on the remote host
- **`--remote-env <ENV>`** — Config environments to load on each target; repeat or separate with commas (for example, ci,dotfiles)
- **`--remote-mise <COMMAND>`** — Existing mise executable name or path; relative paths use the staged project
- **`--skip <PART>`** — Skip these parts on each target

  Repeat the flag or separate parts with commas. Cannot be combined with `--only`.

  **Choices:** `plugins`, `packages`, `accounts`, `files`, `services`, `firewall`, `compose`, `repos`, `dotfiles`, `mise-shell-activate`, `macos-defaults`, `macos-launchd-agents`, `linux-systemd-units`, `user`, `tools`, `task`, `final-hook`
- **`--source <DIR>`** — Local directory to archive and send to each target
- **`--ssh-option <OPTION>`** — OpenSSH `-o` option; repeat for multiple options
- **`--tag <TAG>`** — Select configured hosts with this tag; repeat to match any tag
- **`--update`** — Refresh package metadata and update repositories on each target
- **`-y --yes`** — Skip confirmation prompts on each target
- **`--github-relay-read-only`** — Borrow read-only GitHub access for this run (Linux and macOS only)

  Needs exactly one of `--github-relay-repo` or `--github-relay-all-repos`.
- **`--github-relay-repo <OWNER/REPO>`** — Repository the targets may read through the relay; repeat for more (needs `--github-relay-read-only`)
- **`--github-relay-all-repos`** — Let targets read every repository your local credentials can read (needs `--github-relay-read-only`)
- **`--github-relay-log-requests`** — Log sanitized relay requests on local stderr (needs `--github-relay-read-only`)
- **`--github-relay-no-log-requests`** — Turn off request logging, overriding the `github_relay` settings (needs `--github-relay-read-only`)
- **`--github-relay-log-format <FORMAT>`** — Relay log and summary format, `text` or `jsonl` (needs `--github-relay-read-only`)
- **`--github-relay-max-duration <DURATION>`** — End borrowed access after a duration such as `1h`; `0s` lasts the whole run (needs `--github-relay-read-only`)
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Examples

Preview a run on a host that is not in the inventory

```
mise bootstrap remote --host devbox --dry-run
```

Bootstrap one inventory host

```
mise bootstrap remote cache
```

Bootstrap every inventory host tagged canary, without prompts

```
mise bootstrap remote --tag canary --yes
```

Bootstrap every inventory host and stop at the first failure

```
mise bootstrap remote --all --fail-fast
```

Leave mise installed on the host after the run

```
mise bootstrap remote --host ubuntu@cache.example.com -i ~/.ssh/mise-cache --install-mise
```

Let the host read one private GitHub repository during the run

```
mise bootstrap remote --host devbox --github-relay-read-only --github-relay-repo example/setup
```
